title: Credential rotation checklist (status only — never store secret values here)
instructions: Confirm rotation in Google / SMTP consoles outside this file.
Mark status only: pending | rotated | verified | n_a.
Do not paste passwords, private keys, or webhook secrets into this checklist or chat.
After rotation, restart production only in a planned change window — this checklist does not deploy.

items.label: SMTP password / app password
items.notes: Rotate Gmail app password; update production .env; do not put the new value here.

items.label: Google service-account key
items.notes: Create new IAM key; update env/file; delete old key after verification.

items.label: Google form webhook secret
items.notes: Rotate secret and update Apps Script / form consumer together.

items.label: Google Maps API key HTTP-referrer restrictions
items.notes: Public key by design — confirm Cloud Console application restrictions for production host only.
